comment:
* Capabilities that will be mapped to telecom connection
     * capabilities.

variables.name: SUPPORTS_DOWNGRADE_TO_VOICE_LOCAL
variables.comment:
* For an IMS video call, indicates that the local side of the call supports downgrading
         * from a video call to an audio-only call.

variables.name: SUPPORTS_DOWNGRADE_TO_VOICE_REMOTE
variables.comment:
* For an IMS video call, indicates that the peer supports downgrading to an audio-only
         * call.

variables.name: SUPPORTS_VT_LOCAL_BIDIRECTIONAL
variables.comment: * For an IMS call, indicates that the call supports video locally.

variables.name: SUPPORTS_VT_REMOTE_BIDIRECTIONAL
variables.comment: * For an IMS call, indicates that the peer supports video.

variables.name: IS_EXTERNAL_CONNECTION
variables.comment:
* Indicates that the connection is an external connection (e.g. an instance of the class
         * {@link com.android.internal.telephony.imsphone.ImsExternalConnection}.

variables.name: IS_PULLABLE
variables.comment:
* Indicates that this external connection can be pulled from the remote device to the
         * local device.

variables.name: SUPPORTS_RTT_REMOTE
variables.comment: * For an IMS call, indicates that the peer supports RTT.
